lines.beaver: 요즘 육아는 어때? 아이는 잘 커?
lines.beaver_en: How's parenting these days? Is your kid growing well?
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum yuganeun eottae? aineun jal keo?
lines.learner: 애는 잘 크긴 해. 근데 육아가 정말 힘들어.
lines.en: The kid is growing well. But parenting is really hard.
lines.roman: aeneun jal keugin hae. geunde yugaga jeongmal himdeureo.

lines.learner: 언니랑 형부가 가끔 도와줘. 그래도 힘들어.
lines.en: My sister and her husband help sometimes. It's still hard.
lines.roman: eonnirang hyeongbuga gakkeum dowajwo. geuraedo himdeureo.

lines.beaver_en: What about your in-laws? Do they help a bit?
lines.en: My in-laws are a bit patriarchal. They wanted a son.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, it was a girl. So they're disappointed?
lines.learner: 응. 임신했을 때부터 아들 얘기만 하셨어.
lines.en: Yeah. Since I got pregnant, they only talked about a son.
lines.roman: eung. imsinhaesseul ttaebuteo adeul yaegiman hasyeosseo.

lines.beaver: 아직도 그런 집이 있네. 남편은 뭐래?
lines.beaver_en: Families like that still exist. What does your husband say?
lines.beaver_roman: ajikdo geureon jibi inne. nampyeoneun mworae?
lines.en: He's an only son, so they worry a lot about the family line.

lines.beaver: 대를 꼭 아들이 이어야 해? 이상하다.
lines.beaver_en: Does a son really have to carry on the family line? That's strange.
lines.beaver_roman: daereul kkok adeuri ieoya hae? isanghada.
lines.learner: 시어머니는 대를 꼭 이어야 한다셔. 답답해.
lines.en: My mother-in-law says the line must continue. It's frustrating.
lines.roman: sieomeonineun daereul kkok ieoya handasyeo. dapdapae.

lines.beaver_en: What does your own mother say?
lines.learner: 엄마는 딸이 더 효도한다고 하셔. 위로가 돼.
lines.en: My mom says daughters care for parents more. It comforts me.
lines.roman: eommaneun ttari deo hyodohandago hasyeo. wiroga dwae.

lines.beaver_en: Right. Filial piety has nothing to do with son or daughter.
lines.learner: 따지고 보면 효도는 딸이 더 잘하잖아.
lines.en: When you think about it, daughters are better at caring for parents.
lines.roman: ttajigo bomyeon hyodoneun ttari deo jalhajana.

lines.beaver: 신경 쓰지 마. 애 어릴 때가 제일 힘들어.
lines.beaver_en: Don't worry about it. When kids are little is the hardest.
lines.beaver_roman: singyeong sseuji ma. ae eoril ttaega jeil himdeureo.
lines.learner: 고마워. 애 키우는 건 정말 체력 싸움이야.
lines.en: Thanks. Raising a kid is really a test of stamina.
lines.roman: gomawo. ae kiuneun geon jeongmal cheryeok ssaumiya.

lines.beaver: 힘들면 언제든 전화해. 우리 같이 버티자.
lines.beaver_en: Call me anytime it's hard. Let's get through it together.
lines.beaver_roman: himdeulmyeon eonjedeun jeonhwahae. uri gachi beotija.
lines.learner: 응, 고마워. 너랑 얘기하니까 힘이 난다.
lines.en: Yeah, thanks. Talking with you gives me strength.
lines.roman: eung, gomawo. neorang yaegihanikka himi nanda.
